_comment: Canonical docs-site matrix of locales x versions. The deploy job owns ONE copy of this file and feeds it to every branch build (DOCS_VERSIONS_FILE), so the switchers never drift between the 1.x and 2.x branches. build.php falls back to the values baked here when no env override is set. `branch` is the ref each version is built from — point v2.x at `2.x` once that long-lived branch exists, the way 1.x has one.
